name: Apothecary Cottage
description: Elara's cottage, smelling of dried sage and boiling wildflowers. Bunches of herbs hang from the rafters.
visualTheme: A cozy timber cottage filled with shelves of glass vials, mortars, pestles, and jars of strange ingredients.

history.createdWhy: Built by the town council to provide medical support and tonic brewing.
history.builtWho: Constructed by Oakhaven builders for Elara when she arrived from the Academy.
history.majorEvents: Saved Oakhaven from a swamp-fever plague last spring.
history.whyExists: Acts as the sole provider of healing drafts and herbal preparations in the area.
history.currentConflicts: Wild herbs are getting contaminated by shadow blight spreading from the forest.

npcs.name: Alchemist Elara
dialogue: Nature holds the cure for every wound, and the poison for every foe.
Tread carefully, and respect the plants you harvest.
Need a quick health booster? My salves will keep you standing.
